title: Practice 3: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **происхождение** — происхожде́ние: origin; provenance; lineage; birth, extraction, parentage, descent. Wiktionary: происходи́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **явле́ние** — phenomenon. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: introduction (a means, such as a personal letter, of presenting one person to another)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: уче́ние — learning, instruction, training, drill, exercising; мне́ние — opinion (person's); представле́ние — introduction (a means, such as a personal letter, of presenting one person to another); происхожде́ние — origin.
**явление** — явле́ние: phenomenon; event, occurrence; apparition; scene (in terms of theaters). Wiktionary: яви́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **значе́ние** — significance, meaning, sense. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**значения** — значе́ние: significance, meaning, sense; significance, importance, consequence, weight; (mathematics, physics, computing) value. Wiktionary: зна́чить + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **объясне́ние** — explanation (the act or process of explaining). Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**объяснений** — объясне́ние: explanation (the act or process of explaining). Wiktionary: объясни́ть + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **произведе́ние** — creation. Source: Wiktionary, «-ение» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ение#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**произведение** — произведе́ние: creation; work of art, work (a literary, artistic, or intellectual production); (mathematics) product. Wiktionary: произвести + -е́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **сказа́ние** — legend; saga; story. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: explanation (the act or process of explaining)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: явле́ние — phenomenon; значе́ние — significance, meaning, sense; объясне́ние — explanation (the act or process of explaining); произведе́ние — creation.
